in_sanskrit.name: Sharanshwa
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Protector of the Path
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharanshwa एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Sharanshwa is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Shara’ which means ‘path’ and ‘Ansh’ which means ‘protector’. This name is bestowed upon a child who is believed to be the protector and guide on the path of life.
